violations.text: Raw animal foods such as raw hamburger patties were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as sauces in the lowboy of prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation.
